check.bundledenv.found: {{file}} holds real configuration values and would be handed to everyone. Ship a .env.example with placeholders instead.
check.dangerous.delete_root: Deletes the root or the home directory (rm -rf on /, ~ or $HOME).
check.dangerous.pipe_to_shell: Runs a downloaded script straight in a shell. Download it, look at it, then run it, or name a fixed version and its checksum.
check.dangerous.shell_startup: Writes to a shell startup file (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.profile or the PowerShell profile).
check.dangerous.world_writable: Makes files writable by everyone (chmod 777, a+rwx or o+w).
check.description.no_when: The description says what the skill does but not when to use it. Add a sentence such as "Use when …".
check.description.too_short: The description has {{length}} characters; an AI tool needs at least {{min}} to know when to use the skill.
check.engine.rule_failed: The rule {{rule}} could not finish, so this resource counts as not having passed it: {{error}}
check.injection.exfiltrate: Asks to send credentials or key files somewhere.
check.injection.hidden_char: Contains the invisible character {{codepoint}}, which hides text from review.
check.injection.ignore_instructions: Asks the AI to ignore or override its earlier instructions.
check.overlap.similar: The description is {{similarity}}% the same as that of {{peer}}; one request may pick either skill. Say what sets this one apart.
check.personalpath.home_dir: A home directory with an account name in it ({{system}}) only exists on one computer. Write ~ or $HOME, or a setting in .env.example.
check.personalpath.local_port: A service on localhost:{{port}} only exists on one computer. Make the address a setting in .env.example.
check.secrets.assignment: The setting {{key}} holds what looks like a credential ({{length}} characters). Refer to a personal secret with ${secret:NAME} instead.
check.secrets.high_entropy: A random-looking string of {{length}} characters may be a credential. Refer to a personal secret with ${secret:NAME} instead.
check.secrets.token_like: Looks like a {{kind}} ({{masked}}, {{length}} characters). Remove it, revoke it, and refer to a personal secret with ${secret:NAME} instead.
check.structure.case_clash: Differs from {{other}} only in case; macOS and Windows would make them one file.
check.structure.code_invalid: "{{code}}" is not a valid resource code: 2 to 48 lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.
check.structure.delivery_invalid: delivery is "{{delivery}}"; use native or on-demand.
check.structure.description_missing: The front matter has no description. An AI tool reads it to decide when to use the skill.
check.structure.front_matter_invalid: The front matter is not a YAML mapping.
check.structure.front_matter_missing: SKILL.md does not start with front matter (a line "---").
check.structure.front_matter_unterminate: The front matter has no closing line "---".
check.structure.meta_missing: There is no meta mapping with the resource's name.
check.structure.name_mismatch: The name in the front matter is "{{name}}", but the resource is "{{code}}". They must be the same.
check.structure.name_missing: The front matter has no name.
check.structure.path_too_deep: The path has {{depth}} levels; at most {{limit}} are allowed.
check.structure.path_too_long: The path is {{bytes}} bytes long; at most {{limit}} are allowed.
check.structure.repo.duplicate_code: Another resource has the same code: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.invalid_code: The name is not a valid resource code: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.parse: The resource cannot be read as its kind: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.undefined_ref: Refers to a resource the repository does not have, or one that cannot be used: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.undefined_secret: Refers to a secret the repository does not define: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.undefined_stage: Names a stage the repository does not have: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.unknown_dir: A directory no resource kind uses, skipped: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.unknown_field: A field the format does not have, perhaps misspelt: {{detail}}
check.structure.repo.unknown_product: The scope is not among the repository's products: {{detail}}
check.structure.secret_not_allowed: ${secret:…} is only allowed in env and headers, not in {{field}}: that ends up in process lists and logs.
check.structure.server_command_missing: A stdio server needs a command.
check.structure.server_type_invalid: server.type is "{{type}}"; use stdio, http or sse.
check.structure.server_url_missing: An http or sse server needs a url.
check.structure.too_large: The resource has {{bytes}} bytes; at most {{limit}} are allowed.
check.structure.too_many_files: The resource has {{count}} files; at most {{limit}} are allowed.
